mapper.sql: CASE WHEN a.PERIOD_FLAG = '1' THEN TO_CHAR(CAST(a.DACCT AS DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year', 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHEN a.PERIOD_FLAG = '2' THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.DACCT || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '1 year', 'YYYY-MM') WHEN a.PERIOD_FLAG = '3' THEN CONCAT( TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(a.DACCT,1,4) || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '1 year', 'YYYY'), 'Q', EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TO_DATE(SUBSTR(a.DACCT,1,4) || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))::int ) ELSE TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(a.DACCT,1,4) || '-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') - INTERVAL '1 year', 'YYYY') END
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.gallery_id, a.page_id, a.time_type, a.time_interval, a.content, a.x, a.y, a.w, a.h, a.i, a.title, a.type, a.option, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.query_path, ''), NULLIF(a.query_path, 'null'), g.query_path) AS query_path, a.unit FROM visual_screen.vs_page_info_sub a LEFT JOIN visual_screen.vs_gallery_info g ON a.gallery_id = g.id WHERE 1 = 1 and a.id = #{params.id}

SELECT a.INDEX_NAME AS "INDEX_NAME", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_gemini_structure a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.INDEX_NAME order by a.INDEX_NAME

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_transfer_income a WHERE 1 = 1 and INDEX_NAME = '转移性收入金额' ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} group by a.DACCT order BY a.DACCT

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", LEFT(a.DACCT, 4) AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_transfer_income a LEFT JOIN visual_screen.vs_transfer_income a1 ON a1.DACCT = AND a.AREA_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE and a1.INDEX_NAME = '转移性收入金额' WHERE 1 = 1 and a.INDEX_NAME = '转移性收入金额' ${params.whereInfo} and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.dacct and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_TYPE} GROUP BY LEFT(a.dacct, 4) ORDER BY a.DACCT ORDER BY LEFT(a.DACCT, 4)

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_local_financial_resources a WHERE 1 = 1 and a.INDEX_NAME = '地方债收入本期值' ${params.whereInfo} and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} group BY a.DACCT order BY a.DACCT

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", LEFT(a.DACCT, 4) AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_local_financial_resources a LEFT JOIN visual_screen.vs_local_financial_resources a1 ON a1.DACCT = AND a.AREA_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE and a1.INDEX_NAME = '地方债收入本期值' WHERE 1 = 1 and a.INDEX_NAME = '地方债收入本期值' ${params.whereInfo} and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.dacct and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_TYPE} GROUP BY LEFT(a.dacct, 4) ORDER BY a.DACCT ORDER BY LEFT(a.DACCT, 4)

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_land_transfer a WHERE 1 = 1 and INDEX_NAME = '土地出让收入金额' ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} group BY a.DACCT order BY a.DACCT

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", LEFT(a.DACCT, 4) AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_land_transfer a LEFT JOIN visual_screen.vs_land_transfer a1 ON a1.DACCT = AND a.AREA_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE and a1.INDEX_NAME = '土地出让收入金额' WHERE 1 = 1 and a.INDEX_NAME = '土地出让收入金额' ${params.whereInfo} and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.dacct and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_TYPE} GROUP BY LEFT(a.dacct, 4) ORDER BY a.DACCT ORDER BY LEFT(a.DACCT, 4)

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_public_budget a WHERE 1 = 1 and INDEX_NAME = '一般公共预算收入金额' ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} group BY a.DACCT order BY a.DACCT

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_public_budget a LEFT JOIN visual_screen.vs_public_budget a1 ON a1.DACCT = AND a.AREA_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE and a1.INDEX_NAME = '一般公共预算收入金额' WHERE 1 = 1 and a.INDEX_NAME = '一般公共预算收入金额' ${params.whereInfo} and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} group BY a.DACCT order BY a.DACCT

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", LEFT(a.DACCT, 4) AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_three_budget_revenue a LEFT JOIN visual_screen.vs_three_budget_revenue a1 ON a1.DACCT = AND a.AREA_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE and a1.INDEX_NAME = #{params.INDEX_NAME} WHERE 1 = 1 and a.INDEX_NAME = #{params.INDEX_NAME} ${params.whereInfo} and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.dacct and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_TYPE} GROUP BY LEFT(a.dacct, 4) ORDER BY a.DACCT ORDER BY LEFT(a.DACCT, 4)

SELECT DISTINCT a.DACCT AS "DACCT", LEFT(a.DACCT, 4) AS "DACCT", AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_tax_revenue a LEFT JOIN visual_screen.vs_tax_revenue a1 ON a1.DACCT = AND a.AREA_CODE = a1.AREA_CODE and a1.INDEX_NAME = #{params.INDEX_NAME} WHERE 1 = 1 and a.INDEX_NAME = #{params.INDEX_NAME} ${params.whereInfo} and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.dacct and a.PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_TYPE} GROUP BY LEFT(a.dacct, 4) ORDER BY a.DACCT ORDER BY LEFT(a.DACCT, 4)

SELECT DISTINCT a.area_dscr AS "INDEX_NAME", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(a.INDEX_VALUE_1, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) AS "INDEX_VALUE" FROM visual_screen.vs_five_provinces_in_southwest_china a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.area_dscr ORDER BY ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(a.INDEX_VALUE_1, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) DESC

SELECT a.industrial_type AS "name", AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_industry_tax a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.industrial_type ORDER BY a.industrial_type

SELECT a.industrial_name AS "name", AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_industry_tax a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.industrial_name ORDER BY a.industrial_name

SELECT a.industrial_name AS "name", AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_industry_tax a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.industrial_name ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(a.INDEX_VALUE, 0)) DESC limit 10
SELECT a.INDEX_NAME AS "name", AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_subject_pay a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.INDEX_NAME ORDER BY a.INDEX_NAME
SELECT a.INDEX_NAME AS "name", AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_subject_pay_sub a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.INDEX_NAME ORDER BY a.INDEX_NAME

SELECT a.INDEX_NAME AS "name", AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_purpose_pay a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.INDEX_NAME, a.AREA_DSCR ORDER BY a.INDEX_NAME

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(ROUND(a.BUDGET_COMPLETE / ${params.unit}, 2), 0) AS "BUDGET_COMPLETE", COALESCE(ROUND(a.BUDGET_NOT_COMPLETE / ${params.unit}, 2), 0) AS "BUDGET_NOT_COMPLETE", ROUND(a.BUDGET_RATE * 100, 2) AS "BUDGET_RATE" FROM visual_screen.vs_budgetary_income a WHERE 1 = 1 and INDEX_NAME = '${params.INDEX_NAME}' ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_DSCR AS "SUBJECT_DSCR", ROUND(COALESCE(a.INDEX_VALUE_COMPLETE / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) AS "INDEX_VALUE_COMPLETE", ROUND(COALESCE(a.INDEX_VALUE_NOT_COMPLETE / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) AS "INDEX_VALUE_NOT_COMPLETE", ROUND(COALESCE(a.RATE, 0) * 100, 2) AS "RATE" FROM visual_screen.vs_type_budget a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG}

SELECT a.ORG_TYPE AS "name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT2, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_guoku_and_bank a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.ORG_TYPE ORDER BY ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT2, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) DESC limit 10

SELECT a.ORG_TYPE AS "name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT4, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_guoku_and_bank a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.ORG_TYPE ORDER BY ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT4, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) DESC limit 10

SELECT a.ORG_TYPE AS "name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT3, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_guoku_and_bank a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.ORG_TYPE ORDER BY ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT3, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) DESC limit 10

SELECT a.ORG_TYPE AS "name", ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT1, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) AS "value" FROM visual_screen.vs_guoku_and_bank a WHERE 1 = 1 ${params.whereInfo} and PERIOD_FLAG = #{params.PERIOD_FLAG} GROUP BY a.ORG_TYPE ORDER BY ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(F_AMT1, 0)) / ${params.unit}, 0), 2) DESC limit 10
